conventions.convention: The parameter space is standard Borel, the prior is a probability measure, loss sections are measurable and real-valued, and temperature w>0 multiplies the loss. The update is defined only for a finite positive normalizer.

The KL minimization assumes AC, absolute loss integrability under the update, and competitors ν≪π with finite KL divergence and finite absolute loss expectation. Uniqueness is over precisely this class.
Sequential coherence uses one fixed temperature and assumes every sequential normalizer is finite and positive. For n=0, the cumulative loss is zero and the normalizer and empty product are one.
Natural numbers include zero; the dyadic prior has masses a_k=(1/2)^(k+1), indexed from k=0.
A 0.95-credible set means posterior mass at least 0.95. Coverage instead uses the sampling law at a fixed true parameter.

load_bearing.statement: When 0<Z_w(π,x)<∞, G_{w,π,x}(A)=Z_w(π,x)^{-1}∫_A exp{-wℓ_x(θ)}π(dθ). If the normalizer is zero or infinite, this definition supplies no update.
Let G_{w,π,x} be the update of def-generalized-bayes-loss-update-and-temperature, with prior probability π and normalizer 0<Z_w(π,x)<∞. Then G_{w,π,x} is a probability measure on (Θ,T).

Assuming AC, a measurable real loss, a probability prior, w>0, 0<Z<∞, and ∫|ℓ_x|dq<∞ for q=G_{w,π,x}, let V comprise probabilities ν≪π with D(ν∥π)<∞ and ∫|ℓ_x|dν<∞. Then q∈V and J_w(ν)-J_w(q)=D(ν∥q)≥0 for ν∈V, with equality if and only if ν=q.

seams_checked.note: The supplier's fixed-fiber definition and propriety proposition require finite positive evidence and distinguish fiberwise normalization from a sampling-model conditional law. The consumer preserves those distinctions and separately proves normalization for its exponential loss weight; it asserts neither joint data measurability nor an RCD.

The actual supplier is lem-countable-discrete-space-is-standard-borel. Its statement and complete discrete-metric proof support precisely the nonempty finite and natural-number power-set spaces used by all four examples. The examples invoke no Dirichlet-process construction, conjugacy or support claim.
